<?php
class MathHelper {
    public static function factorial(int $n): int {
        return $n <= 1 ? 1 : $n * self::factorial($n - 1);
    }
}

echo MathHelper::factorial(5);   // 120

<?php
class Counter {
    public static int $count = 0;
    public function __construct() {
        self::$count++;
    }
}

new Counter();
new Counter();
echo Counter::$count;   // 2

<?php
class A {
    public static function create(): self {
        return new self();      // toujours A
    }
    public static function createLate(): static {
        return new static();    // peut etre A ou B
    }
}
class B extends A {}
var_dump(B::create());      // object(A)
var_dump(B::createLate());  // object(B)
